summary: The AI model repository and deployment platform ecosystem in 2026 is highly concentrated, with Hugging Face dominating open-source model hosting at over 2 million models while the top 0.01% of models account for nearly half of all downloads. Deployment-focused platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and AWS Bedrock have emerged to bridge the gap between model repositories and production inference, each targeting different segments from individual developers to enterprise cloud users. Qwen derivatives and OpenAI-compatible APIs have become de facto standards, with hardware vendors AMD and NVIDIA increasingly publishing open models to drive chip adoption.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open-source hub for hosting, sharing, discovering, and fine-tuning machine learning models, datasets, and demo applications
platforms.model_count: 2,000,000+ models (3 million repositories total as of mid-2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and datasets; Pro plan ~$9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference API usage-based pricing per token/request
features: Largest public model repository with 2M+ models and 500K+ datasets
Spaces for hosting interactive ML demos and apps
Inference API and dedicated inference endpoints
AutoTrain for no-code fine-tuning
Model cards, leaderboards, and evaluation frameworks
Transformers, Diffusers, and PEFT library integrations
Top 200 models account for 49.6% of all downloads
30%+ of Fortune 500 companies maintain verified accounts
45.4 billion total Hub downloads as of October 2025
platforms.best_for: Researchers, data scientists, and developers who need to discover, share, fine-tune, or experiment with open-source models across any modality

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runtime and registry enabling developers to download, run, and manage large language models entirely on their own hardware with a simple CLI and REST API
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models in the Ollama library (primarily GGUF-quantized versions of popular open models)
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs are limited to your own hardware and electricity
features: One-command model download and execution (e.g., ollama run llama3)
GGUF format support enabling CPU and mixed CPU/GPU inference
OpenAI-compatible REST API for drop-in integration
Modelfile system for customizing system prompts and parameters
Multi-platform support: macOS (Apple Silicon optimized), Linux, Windows
Model library growing 464% in GGUF repositories on Hugging Face in 2026
Supports Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, DeepSeek, and many more families
Private and offline operation with no data leaving local machine
platforms.best_for: Individual developers, privacy-conscious users, and teams who want to run open-source LLMs locally without cloud costs or data privacy concerns

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform for running open-source and custom machine learning models via a simple API without managing infrastructure
platforms.model_count: 100,000+ public models spanning language, image, video, audio, and more
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute time; CPU from ~$0.0001/second, T4 GPU ~$0.00055/second, A100 ~$0.0023/second; no seat fees or subscriptions required
features: Instant API access to popular open-source models with no setup
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models as containers
Automatic scaling including scale-to-zero to eliminate idle costs
Support for image generation (SDXL, Flux), LLMs, video, and audio models
Webhooks and async prediction support for production workflows
Model versioning and reproducible predictions
Community model sharing and discovery
Python, Node.js, and HTTP client libraries
platforms.best_for: Startups, indie developers, and product teams that need rapid API access to diverse open-source models for prototyping and production without DevOps overhead

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: Cloud inference and fine-tuning platform specializing in fast, cost-efficient serving of leading open-source language and embedding models at scale
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open-source models including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DBRX, and embedding models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token inference; Llama 3.1 8B from ~$0.10/million tokens; Llama 3.1 70B ~$0.88/million tokens; fine-tuning charged per token trained; volume discounts available
features: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Embeddings API
Custom fine-tuning with LoRA on proprietary data
Together Inference Stack optimized for high throughput and low latency
Dedicated endpoints for guaranteed capacity
Mixture-of-Experts model support including DeepSeek and Qwen-MoE
Batch inference for high-volume offline workloads at reduced cost
Safety and moderation tools built in
SOC 2 Type II compliance for enterprise security requirements
platforms.best_for: AI engineers and enterprises needing high-throughput, cost-efficient open-source model inference with fine-tuning capabilities and OpenAI API compatibility

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance generative AI inference platform focused on delivering industry-leading speed and uptime for open-source models in production applications
platforms.model_count: 50+ production-ready models with emphasis on top-tier open-source LLMs, code models, and multimodal models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; Llama 3.1 8B from ~$0.10/million tokens; Llama 3.1 70B ~$0.90/million tokens; serverless and dedicated deployment options; enterprise contracts available
features: FireAttention inference engine delivering some of the fastest open-source model latency benchmarks
OpenAI-compatible API for seamless migration
Compound AI system support for multi-model workflows and function calling
LoRA fine-tuning with rapid deployment of custom adapters
On-demand and reserved capacity options
Structured output and JSON mode enforcement
Multimodal support including vision-language models
SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA-eligible deployment options
platforms.best_for: Production engineering teams and enterprises building latency-sensitive applications that require the fastest possible open-source model inference with enterprise reliability guarantees

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: Fully managed AWS service providing access to a broad selection of foundation models from leading AI companies and open-source providers via a unified API within the AWS ecosystem
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Stability AI, Cohere, Amazon Nova, and AI21 Labs
platforms.pricing: On-demand pay-per-token (e.g., Claude Sonnet ~$3/million input tokens, $15/million output tokens); Provisioned Throughput for reserved capacity billed hourly; model customization charged separately per training token
features: Single API spanning models from Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, Mistral, Amazon Nova, and more
Native AWS IAM, VPC, and PrivateLink integration for enterprise security
Bedrock Agents for building multi-step agentic workflows with tool use
Knowledge Bases for RAG with managed vector store integration
Model customization via fine-tuning and continued pre-training
Guardrails for content filtering and responsible AI policy enforcement
Model Evaluation for automated and human review benchmarking
No data used for model training; data stays within AWS region
Integrated with SageMaker, Lambda, and broader AWS data services
platforms.best_for: Enterprise teams already invested in the AWS ecosystem who need managed, secure, compliant access to both proprietary and open-source foundation models without operating their own inference infrastructure
